description: The first CLI for Sybill: every conversation, deal, and account in your terminal, plus a local store that answers cross-entity questions the web UI can't.

novel_features.name: Deals gone dark
novel_features.description: List open deals with no call activity in the last N days, so nothing stalls silently.

novel_features.name: Weekly call digest
novel_features.description: Pull every call in a window, grouped by deal, with next steps per deal (summaries appear when conversation detail is synced).

novel_features.name: CRM autofill pending diff
novel_features.description: Show the AI-suggested CRM field updates Sybill generated, as a reviewable field-by-field diff.

novel_features.name: Account roll-up
novel_features.description: One offline view per account: call count, open deals by stage, contacts, and last activity.

novel_features.name: Rep activity aggregation
novel_features.description: Per-rep breakdown: calls made, deals touched, and deals gone dark over a window.

novel_features.name: Keyword / objection patterns
novel_features.description: Count and locate transcript mentions of a term, grouped by deal and stage.
